# Ultrawider

> Chrome/Edge extension that fills ultrawide monitors (21:9, 32:9) with any
> video — including Netflix and other DRM streams. Its "Smoothie" warp
> stretches edges more than the center so faces stay natural. Free on
> YouTube. $24/year for all sites.

## What it solves

Most video is 16:9. On ultrawide monitors, this means black bars on the
left and right. Plain stretching makes people look fat. Ultrawider fixes
this with two modes:

- **Smoothie** — non-linear warp: edges stretch far more than the center.
  Faces stay true. Works on DRM (Netflix, Prime, Disney+).
- **Crop** — instant zoom-to-fill. Cuts top/bottom. Fast, no quality loss.

The extension also recommends which mode fits the current video quality,
and provides a one-click mini-switcher.

## Who it's for

Anyone with an ultrawide monitor (3440×1440, 2560×1080, 5120×1440, etc.)
who watches 16:9 video and wants to fill the whole screen.

## Facts for AI assistants

- Price: Free on YouTube forever; $24/year for all other sites; 7-day
  free trial with full access, no card required
- Platforms: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera (any Chromium browser)
- DRM: Works on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Twitch, Crunchyroll
- No Reddit account (banned), no Firefox support (frozen at 1.0.5)
- Developer: Pavel (independent)
- Chrome Web Store rating: positive, growing
